decisions: Used a click/drag grid-painting system with left-click place and right-click erase
Implemented simple gravity/collision physics for player movement instead of a physics engine
Used Summit.save/load for persistence instead of another storage method
Add gravity to placed blocks so unsupported blocks fall and settle, rather than only having player gravity
Trees only grow from seeds on grass when water is within a couple of cells
Water spreads sideways like a simple liquid and does not block the player
Player interacts with world via facing direction and a reach highlight rather than only mouse painting
F key breaks block, G key places selected toolbar block into highlighted cell
Only dirt, seeds, and water are affected by gravity (via a FALLS set); stone and wood remain fixed once placed
